newsitem.title: USA: US propane stocks fall 1.3 mln/bbls in week.
newsitem.headline: US propane stocks fall 1.3 mln/bbls in week.

text.p: U.S. propane stocks fell 1.2 million barrels in the week ending Nov. 1 amid a drop in the Midwest and a slight build in the Gulf Coast, according to the Energy Information Administration report on Wednesday.
The unexpected decline put current total stocks at 49.8 million barrels, about 13 percent, or 6.5 million barrels below year-ago levels.
Stocks in the key U.S. Gulf Coast rose an estimated 200,000 barrels to 23.4 million, nearly 13 percent, or 3 million barrels below last year, said the report.
The Midwest tumbled down 1.3 million barrels in the week to 19.7 million largely because of crop drying and cold weather in the hub. Levels are 15 percent below year-ago levels.
The East Coast, after remaining unchanged for the past two weeks, fell 200,000 barrels in the week.
